rows.label: Transport of trace ideals and their additive-idempotent description

value.scope:
The paper classifies separable nuclear complex $C^*$-algebras after tensoring with the Razak–Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, using their cones of extended lower-semicontinuous traces. The linked formalization proves the ideal-transport part: a trace-cone equivalence induces an order isomorphism of closed two-sided ideals, carrying the ideals determined by finiteness and vanishing of each trace to those of its image.

For each closed ideal $I$, it also constructs the trace that is zero on positive elements of $I$ and infinite elsewhere. These traces are exactly the additive idempotents, meaning $\tau+\tau=\tau$, and their addition recovers ideal inclusion. Spatial classification, existence of the stabilization models, norm uniqueness, and final intertwining are outside this supporting comparison.

points.definitions_to_check: ExtendedTrace: standard extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weight on A₊ (τ(0)=0, additive, τ(rx)=rτ(x) only for r>0, τ(x*x)=τ(xx*), lsc); no density or semifiniteness assumption, matching the paper ; CanonicalConvergence / PreservesCanonicalConvergence / TraceConeEquiv: the cone topology is encoded as convergence of arbitrary filters (limsup of cuts ≤ σ ≤ liminf) instead of a TopologicalSpace, so 'homeomorphism' becomes 'bijection preserving this convergence in both directions'; matches the paper's net criterion but is a nonstandard encoding ; zeroIdeal: defined as finIdeal of the 0/∞-valued supportWeight (closure of {x | τ(x*x)=0}) rather than directly as the kernel ideal; nonstandard presentation, equivalent after unfolding ; [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]: the C*-order is supplied by extra instance arguments instead of Mathlib's CStarAlgebra order; StarOrderedRing.le_iff forces the usual order (standard) ; ClosedIdeal.weight: Classical.choose from closed_ideal_weight_exists; only its forced values (0 on the ideal, ∞ off it) matter (standard) ; NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A: any complex C*-algebra, not nec. separable or nuclear; the supporting lemmas are more general than the paper's setting, which is harmless for a supporting result
points.note: The challenge states only the cone/ideal layer: for arbitrary complex C*-algebras A, B and a TraceConeEquiv F (an additive, scale-preserving bijection of extended-trace cones preserving canonical convergence), the induced order isomorphism of closed ideals sends finIdeal τ and zeroIdeal τ to finIdeal (F τ) and zeroIdeal (F τ), together with the 0/∞ ideal weights, additive idempotents and the order criterion I ≤ J ↔ τ_I + τ_J = τ_I. It contains no tensor product, no W or K, no separability/nuclearity and no *-isomorphism of algebras, so the classification (thm:main) is not stated; the content matches only the supporting Proposition 'Transport of ideals' (st:ideals).

statements.name: thm:main
statements.text:
\label{thm:main}
Let \(A\) and \(B\) be separable nuclear complex \(C^*\)-algebras.
If \(T(A)\) and \(T(B)\) are isomorphic as topological cones, then
\[
 A\otimes\W\otimes\K\ \cong\ B\otimes\W\otimes\K,
\]
where \(\K=\K(\ell^2(\N))\) and all tensor products are spatial.
